examInstructions: 携带学生证、黑色水笔、铅笔、橡皮擦

写作是正式题型，不应仅列辅助训练

vocabulary.title: 2026级专硕英语 U1–U6 词汇资料

units.title: Unit 1 词汇测试
units.instructions: 从本单元词库选择合适的词或短语填空。每项使用一次，按句法填写适当词形。

questions.prompt: The patient reported ___ claudication while walking more than 200 meters, which was relieved after a short rest.
questions.originalPrompt: The patient reported ___ claudication while walking more than 200 meters, which was relieved after a short rest.
questions.explanation: intermittent claudication是间歇性跛行；此处用形容词修饰名词。

questions.prompt: Acute ___ of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) is often triggered by bacterial or viral respiratory infections.
questions.originalPrompt: Acute ___ of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) is often triggered by bacterial or viral respiratory infections.
questions.explanation: acute exacerbation是急性加重；此处是作主语的名词单数，与is一致。

questions.prompt: It is essential for clinicians to ___ both the physical and psychological needs of patients with terminal illness.
questions.originalPrompt: It is essential for clinicians to ___ both the physical and psychological needs of patients with terminal illness.
questions.explanation: address needs/problems意为处理需要或问题；不译“地址”。to后用动词原形。

questions.prompt: Administering analgesics can effectively ___ postoperative pain and improve the patient's quality of recovery.
questions.originalPrompt: Administering analgesics can effectively ___ postoperative pain and improve the patient's quality of recovery.
questions.explanation: alleviate pain/symptoms表示减轻疼痛或症状；can后用原形，不等于彻底治愈。

questions.prompt: The committee reviewed the protocol and the ethical implications ___ before granting final approval.
questions.originalPrompt: The committee reviewed the protocol and the ethical implications ___ before granting final approval.
questions.meaning: 其；关于前面提到的事物的
questions.explanation: the ethical implications thereof指该方案的伦理影响，相当于of that protocol；不是表示“因此”的therefore。
questions.originalMeaning: 其；由此；关于那一点；在其中
notes: 原中文提示把thereof和“在其中”混在一起；本句指of the protocol。保留原中文释义在溯源字段，正文释义收窄。

questions.prompt: The physician decided not to ___ the possibility of acute myocardial infarction solely because the initial ECG and troponin results were normal.
questions.originalPrompt: The attending physician decided to ___ the differential diagnosis of acute myocardial infarction after the ECG and troponin results were normal.
questions.meaning: 不予考虑；摒除（某种可能或想法）
questions.explanation: dismiss a possibility意为不再考虑一种可能；不能简单等同已经科学证实排除。
questions.originalMeaning: 不予考虑；摒除；驳回；让…离开
notes: 原题把初次心电图和肌钙蛋白正常直接连到dismiss心梗，缺临床背景且搭配生硬；保留原题，学习版改成不可仅据此摒除可能性的句子。答案dismiss不变。

externalSources.label: NICE CG95：心电图与肌钙蛋白须结合临床解读

questions.prompt: Early recognition and prompt intervention can ___ a significant improvement in patient outcomes after stroke.
questions.originalPrompt: Early recognition and prompt intervention can ___ a significant improvement in patient outcomes after stroke.
questions.explanation: bring about an improvement表示带来改善；can后整组用原形。

questions.prompt: The hospital will ___ a new antimicrobial stewardship program next quarter to reduce inappropriate antibiotic use.
questions.originalPrompt: The hospital will ___ a new antimicrobial stewardship program next quarter to reduce inappropriate antibiotic use.
questions.explanation: initiate a program/study表示启动项目或研究；will后用原形。
questions.originalMeaning: 开始；发起；启动（治疗、研究等）

questions.prompt: ___ is the branch of medicine dealing with the diagnosis and treatment of disorders of the eye, including cataracts, glaucoma, and retinal diseases.
questions.originalPrompt: ___ is the branch of medicine dealing with the diagnosis and treatment of disorders of the eye, including cataracts, glaucoma, and retinal diseases.
questions.explanation: 眼科专业名；注意ophthalm-中的phth，不要漏写字母。

questions.prompt: In emergency triage, patients with life-threatening conditions such as airway obstruction or massive hemorrhage must ___.
questions.originalPrompt: In emergency triage, patients with life-threatening conditions such as airway obstruction or massive hemorrhage must ___.
questions.meaning: 被优先考虑；被给予首要优先级
questions.explanation: must后接be given构成被动语态；be given first priority也是可用搭配。

questions.prompt: Rural communities often struggle to ___ specialized medical services and advanced diagnostic facilities.
questions.originalPrompt: Rural communities often struggle to ___ specialized medical services and advanced diagnostic facilities.
questions.meaning: 获得使用或接触……的机会
questions.explanation: access to services表示获得服务的机会；struggle to后填get access to，末尾to为介词。
questions.sourceFile: 26级专硕英语单词测试U2new手机版.html

questions.prompt: Patients with a family history of diabetes and a sedentary lifestyle ___ developing cardiovascular complications.
questions.originalPrompt: Patients with a family history of diabetes and a sedentary lifestyle ___ developing cardiovascular complications.
questions.explanation: 复数主语patients用have；of后接名词或动名词，题中已有developing。
questions.sourceFile: 26级专硕英语单词测试U2new手机版.html
sourceFiles: 26级专硕英语单词测试U2new手机版.html

questions.prompt: The evidence strongly supports early screening for breast cancer; ___ colorectal cancer in adults over 50.
questions.originalPrompt: The evidence strongly supports early screening for breast cancer; ___ colorectal cancer in adults over 50.
questions.meaning: 对……来说也是如此；同样适用于
questions.explanation: 主语the same+goes+for后接对象；不是“得出相同结论”。
questions.sourceFile: 26级专硕英语单词测试U2new手机版.html
sourceFiles: 26级专硕英语单词测试U2new手机版.html
notes: come to the same conclusion意为得出相同结论，不能直接填在本空后接colorectal cancer。去掉该错误可接受答案；它作为独立词组保留在词表。
原题的筛查年龄与概括性医学结论仅作为语言情境，不作为当前筛查指南。

questions.prompt: As a general ___, she is often the first point of contact for patients presenting with undiagnosed symptoms in the community.
questions.originalPrompt: As a general ___, she is often the first point of contact for patients presenting with undiagnosed symptoms in the community.
questions.meaning: 执业人员；（医学语境）医师
questions.explanation: general practitioner为全科医师；a general后用单数名词。
questions.sourceFile: 26级专硕英语单词测试U2new手机版.html
sourceFiles: 26级专硕英语单词测试U2new手机版.html

questions.prompt: Long-term consumption of ___ saturated fat and refined sugars is strongly associated with obesity, hypertension, and type 2 diabetes.
questions.originalPrompt: Long-term consumption of ___ saturated fat and refined sugars is strongly associated with obesity, hypertension, and type 2 diabetes.
questions.explanation: high in修饰diet，后接所含成分；题干of后接整组a diet high in。
questions.sourceFile: 26级专硕英语单词测试U2new手机版.html
sourceFiles: 26级专硕英语单词测试U2new手机版.html

questions.prompt: Without appropriate and timely intervention, chronic kidney disease may ___ to end-stage renal failure requiring dialysis or transplantation.
questions.originalPrompt: Without appropriate and timely intervention, chronic kidney disease may ___ to end-stage renal failure requiring dialysis or transplantation.
questions.explanation: progress to意为进展为……；may后用原形。词义不必然表示病情改善。
questions.sourceFile: 26级专硕英语单词测试U2new手机版.html
sourceFiles: 26级专硕英语单词测试U2new手机版.html

questions.prompt: Recent epidemiological studies show that the ___ of myopia among adolescents has risen sharply over the past two decades.
questions.originalPrompt: Recent epidemiological studies show that the ___ of myopia among adolescents has risen sharply over the past two decades.
questions.explanation: 强调一定人群和时间内的新发病例，与prevalence（现患情况/患病率）区分。原题未列研究出处，只作词义语境。

units.selectedSourceFile: 26级专硕英语单词测试U3new手机版.html
units.instructions: 从本单元词库选择合适的词或短语填空。每项使用一次，按句法填写适当词形。

questions.prompt: Following a head injury, the patient exhibited ___ to time and place and had difficulty recognizing family members.
questions.originalPrompt: Following the severe head trauma, the patient exhibited ___ to time and place and was unable to recognize family members, a classic sign of concussion.
questions.explanation: disorientation to time and place指对时间和地点的定向障碍；dis-表达异常/失去，-ation提示名词。
questions.sourceFile: 26级专硕英语单词测试U3new手机版.html
sourceFiles: 26级专硕英语单词测试U3new手机版.html
notes: 原题把严重头伤后不能识人简单归为脑震荡典型表现，诊断表述过度。学习版仅保留定向障碍语境；原句完整留存。

questions.prompt: During the acute phase of delirium, the elderly patient spoke ___ and could not answer even simple questions from the attending physician.
questions.originalPrompt: During the acute phase of delirium, the elderly patient spoke ___ and could not answer even simple questions from the attending physician.
questions.explanation: 修饰spoke需副词incoherently，而非形容词incoherent。
questions.sourceFile: 26级专硕英语单词测试U3new手机版.html
sourceFiles: 26级专硕英语单词测试U3new手机版.html

questions.prompt: Certain over-the-counter medications may ___ the absorption of prescribed antibiotics, so drug interactions must be carefully reviewed.
questions.originalPrompt: Certain over-the-counter medications may ___ the absorption of prescribed antibiotics, so drug interactions must be carefully reviewed.
questions.explanation: interfere with absorption表示干扰吸收；with为固定搭配的一部分，不能遗漏。
questions.sourceFile: 26级专硕英语单词测试U3new手机版.html
sourceFiles: 26级专硕英语单词测试U3new手机版.html

questions.prompt: An abdominal aortic aneurysm can be life-threatening if it is allowed to ___, leading to massive internal hemorrhage.
questions.originalPrompt: An abdominal aortic aneurysm can be life-threatening if it is allowed to ___, leading to massive internal hemorrhage.
questions.explanation: allowed to后填动词原形rupture；同词也可作名词。
questions.sourceFile: 26级专硕英语单词测试U3new手机版.html
sourceFiles: 26级专硕英语单词测试U3new手机版.html

questions.prompt: Prolonged ischemia in the brain tissue can cause ___ neurological damage, which cannot be reversed even after blood flow is restored.
questions.originalPrompt: Prolonged ischemia in the brain tissue can cause ___ neurological damage, which cannot be reversed even after blood flow is restored.
questions.meaning: 不可逆的；不能恢复原状的
questions.explanation: 修饰neurological damage用形容词；irreversible与后文cannot be reversed呼应。
questions.sourceFile: 26级专硕英语单词测试U3new手机版.html

questions.prompt: Diabetic patients must monitor their blood ___ levels regularly to prevent both hyperglycemia and hypoglycemic episodes.
questions.originalPrompt: Diabetic patients must monitor their blood ___ levels regularly to prevent both hyperglycemia and hypoglycemic episodes.
questions.explanation: blood glucose levels为血糖水平；glucose不写作glucoses来修饰levels。

sourceFiles: 26级专硕英语单词测试U3new手机版.html

questions.prompt: Recent molecular studies ___ a specific gene mutation in the pathogenesis of this rare inherited cardiac disorder.
questions.originalPrompt: Recent molecular studies ___ a specific gene mutation in the pathogenesis of this rare inherited cardiac disorder.
questions.explanation: implicate A in B意为提示A参与/与B有关；复数studies可接现在式implicate，原句也允许过去式implicated。

questions.prompt: The kidneys play a crucial role in helping to ___ metabolic waste products and excess fluid from the bloodstream.
questions.originalPrompt: The kidneys play a crucial role in helping to ___ metabolic waste products and excess fluid from the bloodstream.
questions.explanation: eliminate waste表示清除废物；helping to后用原形eliminate。

units.instructions: 从本单元词库选择合适的词或短语填空。每项使用一次，按句法填写适当词形。

questions.prompt: Combination antiretroviral ___ has dramatically improved the life expectancy of patients living with HIV.
questions.originalPrompt: Combination antiretroviral ___ has dramatically improved the life expectancy of patients living with HIV.
questions.explanation: combination antiretroviral therapy为联合抗逆转录病毒治疗；句中has要求单数/不可数therapy，不接受therapies。
questions.sourceFile: 26级专硕英语单词测试U4new手机版.html
sourceFiles: 26级专硕英语单词测试U4new手机版.html

questions.prompt: Socioeconomic status is recognized as a major social ___ of health, influencing access to care and long-term outcomes.
questions.originalPrompt: Socioeconomic status is recognized as a major social ___ of health, influencing access to care and long-term outcomes.
questions.explanation: a major social determinant of health中a要求单数名词；不是形容词determined。
questions.sourceFile: 26级专硕英语单词测试U4new手机版.html
sourceFiles: 26级专硕英语单词测试U4new手机版.html

questions.prompt: Pregnant women are commonly advised to take folic acid as a dietary ___ to reduce the risk of neural tube defects.
questions.originalPrompt: Pregnant women are commonly advised to take folic acid as a dietary ___ to reduce the risk of neural tube defects.
questions.explanation: a dietary supplement为膳食补充剂；本空为单数名词，不能填supplemented或supplements。
questions.sourceFile: 26级专硕英语单词测试U4new手机版.html

questions.prompt: Some ___ antibiotics are manufactured by chemical synthesis rather than isolated directly from natural sources.
questions.originalPrompt: Penicillin and other ___ antibiotics are chemically manufactured rather than isolated directly from natural sources.
questions.explanation: 修饰antibiotics用形容词。原题将penicillin一概纳入全合成制品不准确，学习题干已更正。

questions.originalPrompt: Insulin is a small protein ___ that binds to receptors on cell surfaces to regulate glucose uptake.
questions.explanation: a small protein molecule为一个小蛋白质分子；a限定单数，不能填molecules。

questions.prompt: Antisense ___ therapies are designed to bind complementary mRNA sequences and modulate gene expression in genetic diseases.

questions.explanation: oligo-表示少量，nucleotide为核苷酸。作therapies前的名词定语时用oligonucleotide；原页面允许的ogligonucleotide是拼写错误。

questions.originalPrompt: Nanoparticle-based drug carriers can ___ chemotherapeutic agents specifically to tumor tissue, reducing systemic toxicity.
questions.explanation: deliver agents to tissue表示把药物递送到组织；can后用原形。题句是语言练习，不证明所有载体都能精确靶向或降低毒性。

questions.meaning: 碰运气的；缺乏系统性的
questions.explanation: 形容结果不稳定、方法缺乏计划。原词表要求保留连字符，不接受连写hitor-miss等拼法。

units.title: Unit 5 词汇测试
units.instructions: 从本单元词库选择合适的词或短语填空。每项使用一次，按句法填写适当词形。

questions.prompt: The social ___ surrounding mental illness can prevent patients from seeking timely treatment.
questions.originalPrompt: The social ___ surrounding mental illness can prevent patients from seeking timely treatment.
questions.explanation: social stigma surrounding mental illness指围绕精神疾病的社会污名；不是身体症状。

questions.prompt: Clinicians should ___ the patient’s concerns before explaining the treatment plan.
questions.originalPrompt: Clinicians should ___ the patient’s concerns before explaining the treatment plan.
questions.explanation: acknowledge concerns指承认、重视患者关切；不等于已经同意所有主张。should后用原形。

questions.prompt: The approval of national drug policy falls outside the ___ of this hospital committee.
questions.originalPrompt: The approval of national drug policy falls outside the ___ of this hospital committee.
questions.explanation: within/outside the purview of表示在某机构职责范围之内/之外。

questions.prompt: The resident adopted an ___ tone when asking about the patient’s medication history.
questions.originalPrompt: The resident adopted an ___ tone when asking about the patient’s medication history.
questions.explanation: an inquiring tone表示探询的语气；可接受英式拼写enquiring。

questions.prompt: Researchers should not be ___ influenced by a single abnormal laboratory result.
questions.originalPrompt: Researchers should not be ___ influenced by a single abnormal laboratory result.
questions.explanation: unduly influenced意为受到不适当或过度的影响；副词修饰influenced。

questions.prompt: The intervention is recommended when the patient’s pain reaches a clinically significant ___.
questions.originalPrompt: The intervention is recommended when the patient’s pain reaches a clinically significant ___.
questions.explanation: reach a threshold表示达到某个界限；本题只练词义，没有给真实诊疗阈值。

questions.prompt: The physician prepared a ___ diagnosis that included infection, inflammation, and malignancy.
questions.originalPrompt: The physician prepared a ___ diagnosis that included infection, inflammation, and malignancy.
questions.explanation: differential diagnosis为鉴别诊断；不要把它理解成一个已经确诊的疾病。

questions.prompt: The patient’s chief ___ was persistent chest discomfort after exercise.
questions.originalPrompt: The patient’s chief ___ was persistent chest discomfort after exercise.
questions.explanation: chief complaint为主诉；这里不是投诉，was对应单数complaint。

questions.prompt: Informed consent is a ___ step before enrollment in the clinical trial.
questions.originalPrompt: Informed consent is a ___ step before enrollment in the clinical trial.
questions.explanation: a requisite step表示必要步骤；本空为形容词，区别名词requisition（申请/征用）。

questions.prompt: Open-ended questions can ___ important information that patients may not volunteer spontaneously.
questions.originalPrompt: Open-ended questions can ___ important information that patients may not volunteer spontaneously.
questions.explanation: elicit information/a response表示通过提问等引出信息或反应；can后用原形。

questions.prompt: The ___ of ordinary sadness may lead to unnecessary labeling and treatment.
questions.originalPrompt: The ___ of ordinary sadness may lead to unnecessary labeling and treatment.
questions.explanation: 把某种生活现象用医学问题框架界定或处理；题中ordinary sadness是讨论示例。英式拼写medicalisation也可接受。

questions.prompt: Delayed follow-up resulted in a ___ response to the initial therapy.
questions.originalPrompt: Delayed follow-up resulted in a ___ response to the initial therapy.
questions.meaning: 未达最佳的；不够理想的
questions.explanation: sub-在此提示低于理想水平；suboptimal不等于完全没有效果。

questions.prompt: The pharmacist explained the possible ___ effects of the new medication.
questions.originalPrompt: The pharmacist explained the possible ___ effects of the new medication.
questions.explanation: adverse effects为不良影响/不良反应；区别averse（反感的，通常接to）。

questions.prompt: Severe dehydration may require ___ for intravenous fluid replacement.
questions.originalPrompt: Severe dehydration may require ___ for intravenous fluid replacement.
questions.explanation: hospitalization for...表示因……住院；英式拼写hospitalisation也可接受。

units.title: Unit 6 词汇测试
units.instructions: 从本单元词库选择合适的词或短语填空。每项使用一次，按句法填写适当词形。

questions.prompt: The patient gave an ___ account of the symptoms, describing their onset and progression in precise detail.
questions.originalPrompt: The patient gave an ___ account of the symptoms, describing their onset and progression in precise detail.
questions.explanation: 本题指定形容词；express instructions/permission是更常见搭配。原题express account搭配不典型，不能把express背成“详细的”同义词。
notes: express作形容词的明示/明确义可核实，但express account搭配不典型；保留原题和词库指定答案，另提供常见搭配解释，不扩展成“详细”的普遍同义词。
原词库指定express，但原搭配不典型；本题展示原答案供自评，不强行自动判定其他合理表达错误。

questions.prompt: The multidisciplinary team struggled to control the patient’s ___ neuropathic pain despite several treatment attempts.
questions.originalPrompt: The multidisciplinary team struggled to control the patient’s ___ neuropathic pain despite several treatment attempts.
questions.meaning: 难以控制或处理的；难治的
questions.explanation: intractable pain为难治性疼痛；不等于简单的疼痛程度高，也不等于永久无治疗可能。

questions.prompt: A single well-documented ___ can disprove the claim that this symptom always indicates infection.
questions.originalPrompt: A single well-documented ___ can disprove the claim that this symptom always indicates infection.
questions.explanation: 一个反例可推翻“所有/总是”的普遍断言；counter-在此表示相反、反驳。

questions.prompt: The review should ___ both the biological mechanisms and the social factors affecting treatment adherence.
questions.originalPrompt: The review should ___ both the biological mechanisms and the social factors affecting treatment adherence.
questions.explanation: encompass both A and B意为同时涵盖A与B；should后用原形。

questions.prompt: The counselor explained that the disorder may follow a pattern of autosomal dominant ___.
questions.originalPrompt: The counselor explained that the disorder may follow a pattern of autosomal dominant ___.
questions.explanation: autosomal dominant inheritance为常染色体显性遗传；本题是医学遗传义，不是财产继承。

questions.prompt: The findings are useful ___ as they clarify how medication adherence affects long-term outcomes.
questions.originalPrompt: The findings are useful ___ as they clarify how medication adherence affects long-term outcomes.
questions.explanation: insofar as引出限定：就……而言/在……程度上。空后已有as，只填insofar；in so far也可接受。

questions.prompt: The report was written ___ for clinicians who manage patients with treatment-resistant depression.
questions.originalPrompt: The report was written ___ for clinicians who manage patients with treatment-resistant depression.
questions.explanation: written specifically for...表示专为……撰写；-ly副词修饰written。

questions.prompt: When interpreting the result, researchers should not ___ the possibility of sampling bias.
questions.originalPrompt: When interpreting the result, researchers should not ___ the possibility of sampling bias.
questions.explanation: discount a possibility表示轻视/不充分考虑一种可能，不是打折出售；should not后用原形。

questions.prompt: The patient became ___ aware of the chest pain after climbing two flights of stairs.
questions.originalPrompt: The patient became ___ aware of the chest pain after climbing two flights of stairs.
questions.explanation: acutely aware of表示强烈地/敏锐地意识到；不将这里的acutely机械译作“急性地”。

questions.prompt: After the overdose, the patient remained ___ and required continuous monitoring in the intensive care unit.
questions.originalPrompt: After the overdose, the patient remained ___ and required continuous monitoring in the intensive care unit.
questions.explanation: remain comatose表示仍处于昏迷状态；coma为名词，comatose为形容词。

questions.prompt: The evidence was insufficient to ___ exposing participants to the additional procedural risk.
questions.originalPrompt: The evidence was insufficient to ___ exposing participants to the additional procedural risk.
questions.meaning: 证明……正当或有充分理由
questions.explanation: justify doing something：证明做某事有充分理由；to后填justify，后面已有exposing。

terms.explanation: intermittent claudication是间歇性跛行；此处用形容词修饰名词。
acute exacerbation是急性加重；此处是作主语的名词单数，与is一致。
address needs/problems意为处理需要或问题；不译“地址”。to后用动词原形。
alleviate pain/symptoms表示减轻疼痛或症状；can后用原形，不等于彻底治愈。

terms.meaning: 其；关于前面提到的事物的
terms.explanation: the ethical implications thereof指该方案的伦理影响，相当于of that protocol；不是表示“因此”的therefore。
terms.originalMeaning: 其；由此；关于那一点；在其中

terms.meaning: 不予考虑；摒除（某种可能或想法）
terms.explanation: dismiss a possibility意为不再考虑一种可能；不能简单等同已经科学证实排除。
terms.originalMeaning: 不予考虑；摒除；驳回；让…离开

externalSources.label: NICE CG95：心电图与肌钙蛋白须结合临床解读

terms.explanation: bring about an improvement表示带来改善；can后整组用原形。
initiate a program/study表示启动项目或研究；will后用原形。
terms.originalMeaning: 开始；发起；启动（治疗、研究等）

terms.explanation: 眼科专业名；注意ophthalm-中的phth，不要漏写字母。
terms.sourceFile: 26级专硕英语单词测试U2new手机版.html

terms.meaning: 被优先考虑；被给予首要优先级
terms.explanation: must后接be given构成被动语态；be given first priority也是可用搭配。
terms.sourceFile: 26级专硕英语单词测试U2new手机版.html

terms.meaning: 获得使用或接触……的机会
terms.explanation: access to services表示获得服务的机会；struggle to后填get access to，末尾to为介词。
terms.sourceFile: 26级专硕英语单词测试U2new手机版.html

terms.explanation: 复数主语patients用have；of后接名词或动名词，题中已有developing。
terms.sourceFile: 26级专硕英语单词测试U2new手机版.html

terms.meaning: 对……来说也是如此；同样适用于
terms.explanation: 主语the same+goes+for后接对象；不是“得出相同结论”。
terms.sourceFile: 26级专硕英语单词测试U2new手机版.html

terms.meaning: 执业人员；（医学语境）医师
terms.explanation: general practitioner为全科医师；a general后用单数名词。
terms.sourceFile: 26级专硕英语单词测试U2new手机版.html

terms.explanation: high in修饰diet，后接所含成分；题干of后接整组a diet high in。
terms.sourceFile: 26级专硕英语单词测试U2new手机版.html

terms.explanation: progress to意为进展为……；may后用原形。词义不必然表示病情改善。
terms.sourceFile: 26级专硕英语单词测试U2new手机版.html

terms.explanation: 强调一定人群和时间内的新发病例，与prevalence（现患情况/患病率）区分。原题未列研究出处，只作词义语境。
terms.sourceFile: 26级专硕英语单词测试U2new手机版.html

terms.explanation: 原词表的附加短语。它和the same goes for句法不同，不能直接代入U2第5空；可说The two teams came to the same conclusion.（教学自拟）
terms.sourceFile: 26级专硕英语单词测试U2new手机版.html

terms.explanation: disorientation to time and place指对时间和地点的定向障碍；dis-表达异常/失去，-ation提示名词。
terms.sourceFile: 26级专硕英语单词测试U3new手机版.html

terms.explanation: 修饰spoke需副词incoherently，而非形容词incoherent。
terms.sourceFile: 26级专硕英语单词测试U3new手机版.html

terms.explanation: interfere with absorption表示干扰吸收；with为固定搭配的一部分，不能遗漏。
terms.sourceFile: 26级专硕英语单词测试U3new手机版.html

terms.explanation: allowed to后填动词原形rupture；同词也可作名词。
terms.sourceFile: 26级专硕英语单词测试U3new手机版.html

terms.meaning: 不可逆的；不能恢复原状的
terms.explanation: 修饰neurological damage用形容词；irreversible与后文cannot be reversed呼应。
terms.sourceFile: 26级专硕英语单词测试U3new手机版.html

terms.explanation: blood glucose levels为血糖水平；glucose不写作glucoses来修饰levels。
terms.sourceFile: 26级专硕英语单词测试U3new手机版.html

terms.explanation: implicate A in B意为提示A参与/与B有关；复数studies可接现在式implicate，原句也允许过去式implicated。
terms.sourceFile: 26级专硕英语单词测试U3new手机版.html

terms.explanation: eliminate waste表示清除废物；helping to后用原形eliminate。
terms.sourceFile: 26级专硕英语单词测试U3new手机版.html

terms.explanation: combination antiretroviral therapy为联合抗逆转录病毒治疗；句中has要求单数/不可数therapy，不接受therapies。
terms.sourceFile: 26级专硕英语单词测试U4new手机版.html

terms.explanation: a major social determinant of health中a要求单数名词；不是形容词determined。
terms.sourceFile: 26级专硕英语单词测试U4new手机版.html

terms.explanation: a dietary supplement为膳食补充剂；本空为单数名词，不能填supplemented或supplements。
terms.sourceFile: 26级专硕英语单词测试U4new手机版.html

terms.explanation: 修饰antibiotics用形容词。原题将penicillin一概纳入全合成制品不准确，学习题干已更正。
terms.sourceFile: 26级专硕英语单词测试U4new手机版.html

externalSources.label: ACS：青霉素发现与发酵生产

terms.explanation: a small protein molecule为一个小蛋白质分子；a限定单数，不能填molecules。
terms.sourceFile: 26级专硕英语单词测试U4new手机版.html

terms.explanation: oligo-表示少量，nucleotide为核苷酸。作therapies前的名词定语时用oligonucleotide；原页面允许的ogligonucleotide是拼写错误。
terms.sourceFile: 26级专硕英语单词测试U4new手机版.html

terms.explanation: deliver agents to tissue表示把药物递送到组织；can后用原形。题句是语言练习，不证明所有载体都能精确靶向或降低毒性。
terms.sourceFile: 26级专硕英语单词测试U4new手机版.html

terms.meaning: 碰运气的；缺乏系统性的
terms.explanation: 形容结果不稳定、方法缺乏计划。原词表要求保留连字符，不接受连写hitor-miss等拼法。
terms.sourceFile: 26级专硕英语单词测试U4new手机版.html

terms.explanation: social stigma surrounding mental illness指围绕精神疾病的社会污名；不是身体症状。
acknowledge concerns指承认、重视患者关切；不等于已经同意所有主张。should后用原形。
within/outside the purview of表示在某机构职责范围之内/之外。
an inquiring tone表示探询的语气；可接受英式拼写enquiring。
unduly influenced意为受到不适当或过度的影响；副词修饰influenced。
reach a threshold表示达到某个界限；本题只练词义，没有给真实诊疗阈值。
differential diagnosis为鉴别诊断；不要把它理解成一个已经确诊的疾病。
chief complaint为主诉；这里不是投诉，was对应单数complaint。
a requisite step表示必要步骤；本空为形容词，区别名词requisition（申请/征用）。
elicit information/a response表示通过提问等引出信息或反应；can后用原形。
把某种生活现象用医学问题框架界定或处理；题中ordinary sadness是讨论示例。英式拼写medicalisation也可接受。

terms.meaning: 未达最佳的；不够理想的
terms.explanation: sub-在此提示低于理想水平；suboptimal不等于完全没有效果。
adverse effects为不良影响/不良反应；区别averse（反感的，通常接to）。
hospitalization for...表示因……住院；英式拼写hospitalisation也可接受。
本题指定形容词；express instructions/permission是更常见搭配。原题express account搭配不典型，不能把express背成“详细的”同义词。

terms.meaning: 难以控制或处理的；难治的
terms.explanation: intractable pain为难治性疼痛；不等于简单的疼痛程度高，也不等于永久无治疗可能。
一个反例可推翻“所有/总是”的普遍断言；counter-在此表示相反、反驳。
encompass both A and B意为同时涵盖A与B；should后用原形。
autosomal dominant inheritance为常染色体显性遗传；本题是医学遗传义，不是财产继承。
insofar as引出限定：就……而言/在……程度上。空后已有as，只填insofar；in so far也可接受。

remain comatose表示仍处于昏迷状态；coma为名词，comatose为形容词。

terms.meaning: 证明……正当或有充分理由
terms.explanation: justify doing something：证明做某事有充分理由；to后填justify，后面已有exposing。

grading.exactPolicy: 只比较acceptedAnswers审定数组；不删除所有空格、不作词干前缀匹配、不自动接受任意时态/复数。
grading.selfPolicy: gradingMode=self时展示原词库目标和解释供学习者自评，不作自动判错。

notes: 原资料为58道词库填空；本期考试词汇题型以另行提供的2026考纲为准，不能由练习页面推断考试也为填空。
全部原题、原答案和来源文件名保留；有修改的学习版题干与原题并存。释义和解释除U1原释义外由网站依据语境整理，疑项有标记。
U1未实际显示的中文释义与旧gradePart1函数不计为额外试题，相关词义仍全部保留。
医学例句用于英语练习；不把概括性临床、筛查或治疗表述视为当前诊疗规则。
